conventions: Paths are relative to the repo root. Line numbers were read in the working tree on 2026-11-04: the change under review is uncommitted (the working tree's diff against HEAD on branch claude/project-thread-xqvgpc; there is no refs/ux-review/last). Search for the code a line points at if it has moved.
Branch: claude/project-thread-xqvgpc, not dev. No package pushes, merges or touches main.

The four packages share no app file, so they can all run side by side. Files more than one package touches are only the ARB catalogs, lib/l10n/generated/ and test files (P327 and P330 both edit the ARBs and App/test/ux_previews/meeting_previews.dart; P327 and P328 both add tests to App/test/meeting_screens_test.dart). Change only the keys, tests and preview entries your brief names; don't reorder or reformat anything else there.

Copy is exact, shown as ES, EN and CA. EN between “ ”, ES and CA between « ». Keep the catalogs' marks: ’ in English and Catalan, «…» in Spanish and Catalan. Every changed string changes in all three ARB files (App/docs/LOCALIZATION.md); run flutter gen-l10n after an ARB change and never edit lib/l10n/generated/ by hand.

Owner decisions bind every package and are not reopened: D1, D3, D4, D5 and D6 of 2026-11-04 (.claude/ux-review/DECISIONS.md, the 2026-11-03 entry). In particular D3: one sentence and one «Continuar», asked once per phone, never after a refusal; no title, no second button, no second ask.
Evidence this run is widget tests, preview renders and code only: no Android SDK or emulator. Anything about what Android itself shows goes in deviceChecks, never in acceptance.

packages.title: The first meeting's notification card: say what it asks, survive a stray tap, and answer when Android shows nothing
brief: Context: D3 (UX-2813) is `_askNotifications` in App/lib/screens/meeting_screen.dart:314-350. The first time a meeting records with TaskFlow's notifications off it marks the ask as spent (`store.setMeetingNotificationsAsked()`, :325), shows an AlertDialog with `l.meetingNotifyAsk` and one FilledButton «Continuar» (key `meeting-notify-continue`), and on «Continuar» calls `access.requestPermission()` and ignores its result (:345-349). Keep that shape: one sentence, one button, asked once per phone, recording going on behind it. Three findings, all in this one method plus its copy.

UX-2901 (S2), the sentence: today it is a purpose clause with no main clause and a pronoun with no antecedent («Para pararla desde la notificación…»; in Catalan «Per aturar-la» can only mean «la reunió», since the screen says «l’enregistrament»). Replace `meetingNotifyAsk` in all three ARBs with one whole sentence that names the recording and the notifications: ES (App/lib/l10n/app_es.arb:1509) «Activa las notificaciones para parar la grabación desde ahí y saber cuándo están listas las notas.»; EN (App/lib/l10n/app_en.arb:4482) “Turn on notifications to stop the recording from there and to know when the notes are ready.”; CA (App/lib/l10n/app_ca.arb:1213) «Activa les notificacions per aturar l’enregistrament des d’allà i saber quan les notes estan llestes.» (typographic ’, as the catalog uses). Update `@meetingNotifyAsk`'s description: drop “It refers to the recording.” and say it is one whole sentence that names the recording and the notifications, shown with no title. Keep `meetingNotifyAskContinue` («Continuar», “Continue”, «Continua») unchanged. No title, no second line.

UX-2904 (S2), a stray tap: `showDialog` at meeting_screen.dart:331 uses the default `barrierDismissible: true`, so a brush of the dimmed screen closes the card and, because the ask was already marked spent, this phone never asks again. Pass `barrierDismissible: false` on this one `showDialog`. Back still closes the card (a deliberate act) and, as today, closing it opens no Android dialog (ON-6). Don't move `setMeetingNotificationsAsked()`: D3 says asked once whatever the answer. Don't touch any other dialog on the screen.

UX-2902 (S2), «Continuar» doing nothing: on Android 7–12, and on 13+ once the permission is turned off in Settings or refused twice, `requestPermission()` shows no dialog and returns false, so «Continuar» just closes the card. Handle a false result the way `turnOnReminders` does (App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:294-302), with existing copy only: capture `ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)` and `context.l10n` before awaiting the dialog; then, if `await access.requestPermission()` returns false, or throws (replace the empty catch at :347-349), and the screen is still mounted, call `showFeedback(messenger, l.notificationPermissionOff, actionLabel: l.allowNotifications, onAction: () => unawaited(access.openNotificationSettings()))` (`showFeedback` is in App/lib/widgets/app_components.dart:12; the screen already uses it at :366). That reads ES «El teléfono no deja que TaskFlow te avise.» with «Permitir avisos», EN “Your phone isn’t letting TaskFlow notify you.” with “Allow notifications”, CA «El telèfon no deixa que TaskFlow t’avisi.» with «Permet els avisos». Do NOT call `turnOnReminders` or `_finishOnReturn`: they switch reminders on, which this card never promised. A true result shows nothing new. No new string, no new ask, and nothing is asked again on a later meeting.

Tests (App/test/meeting_screens_test.dart, group “The owner's decisions of 2026-11-04”, :4325-4360): the test 'D3: closing the sentence asks nothing more…' closes the card with `tester.tapAt(const Offset(10, 10))` (:4341); change it so a tap on the scrim leaves the card up, then Back (`tester.binding.handlePopRoute()` or the equivalent) closes it with `permissionRequests` still 0 and the ask marked spent. Add a test where the fake (`FakeReminderAccess`, App/test/support/reminder_fixtures.dart:57-90) refuses: after «Continuar», the feedback line and «Permitir avisos» show, and its action opens the notification settings (`notificationSettingsOpened` becomes 1). Keep the other D3 tests passing.
Preview: in App/test/ux_previews/meeting_previews.dart:255-258 ('notify-ask'), update the description to the new sentence (it currently paraphrases the old one), and keep its variants.
Don't touch: the D5 audio line, the recording layout, `ReminderPreferenceStore`, the notification service, or when the card shows.
acceptance: On the recording screen in state notify-ask, in Spanish at 1×, the card reads exactly «Activa las notificaciones para parar la grabación desde ahí y saber cuándo están listas las notas.» with one «Continuar» and no title; in English “Turn on notifications to stop the recording from there and to know when the notes are ready.” with “Continue”; in Catalan «Activa les notificacions per aturar l’enregistrament des d’allà i saber quan les notes estan llestes.» with «Continua».

At 2× text on 360×740, in Spanish, Catalan and English, the whole sentence and the button show in the card with nothing cut off (renders `meetings/recording.notify-ask.{es.light.2x, ca.light.2x, en.light.2x}`).

In state notify-ask, a tap on the dimmed area outside the card leaves the card showing; Back then closes it, Android's permission request is not made (permissionRequests 0), recording goes on (the help line shows) and the ask is marked spent.
AUDIT's TalkBack list for `meetings/recording · notify-ask` no longer has the scrim's «Cerrar» dismiss node, and reads the new sentence.

With notifications off and a permission request that returns false, in Spanish: after «Continuar», the card closes and the message «El teléfono no deja que TaskFlow te avise.» shows with the action «Permitir avisos»; tapping it opens TaskFlow's notification settings (once), and reminders stay as they were.
With a permission request that returns true, no message shows after «Continuar» and the recording screen is unchanged; on a later meeting the card does not show again in either case.
deviceChecks: Android 12 or lower with TaskFlow's notifications off: the first meeting's «Continuar» shows the «Permitir avisos» line, and the action opens TaskFlow's notification page.
Android 13+ after turning TaskFlow's notifications off in Settings (or two refusals): same as above; and a first refusal in Android's own dialog shows the same line.

After granting mid-recording: whether the recording's notification with Parar and Descartar shows in the shade at once, or only when the next piece starts (`MeetingAudioEngine.next` re-posts it about every 5 minutes). If only later, report it: the card promises stopping from there.
TalkBack on the card over a running recording: focus lands on the card, reads «Alerta», then the sentence, then «Continuar», and no «Cerrar».

packages.title: A meeting note's bottom bar is right from the first frame, every time it opens
brief: Context: D1 (UX-2722) made «Crear tarea» depend on `meetingNotesProvider` (App/lib/widgets/note_task.dart:33-43), an `autoDispose` FutureProvider read only when a note's page opens. While it loads, `makesTask` (App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:291-296) is false, so the placeholder that holds the main button's place (`if (!linksRead && makesTask)`, :566) never shows: the bar first draws one filled «Editar nota» (the recipe layout), then a moment later becomes filled «Crear tarea» + outlined «Editar nota». Because of `autoDispose` this happens on every open. It breaks R1-P318-1's guarantee, which `noteTasksProvider` keeps by being keep-alive and pre-read in App/lib/screens/main_shell.dart:88-90.

1. Make `meetingNotesProvider` keep-alive (drop `.autoDispose`) and pre-read it in main_shell.dart next to `noteTasksProvider`: `ref.listen(meetingNotesProvider, (_, _) {});`, extending the comment at :88-89 to name both reads.

2. Keep it current without re-reading on every open: inside `meetingNotesProvider`, besides `captureOwnerProvider`, watch the task list's notes through a `select` whose value changes only when a note is added or removed, for example `ref.watch(taskProvider.select((s) => s.value?.where((t) => t.isNote && t.id != null).map((t) => t.id).join(',')))` (a String, so equality is by value). A meeting's note saved by the app (`onNotesSaved` → `taskProvider.notifier.showLocal()`, App/lib/services/meeting_controller.dart:526-527) or by the background worker (shown when the task list reloads) then re-reads the marks, and Riverpod keeps the previous value while it does, so `hasValue` stays true. Don't import widgets from services and don't edit meeting_controller.dart or meeting_store.dart. Update the provider's doc comment (it says “read again each time a note's page opens”). Keep the try/catch that returns an empty set.

3. In task_detail_screen.dart, while either read is pending (`!linksRead`, :285-288), hold the main button's place for any note with an open step, not only when `makesTask` is known: compute `final holds = !linksRead && task.isNote && task.checklist.any((step) => !step.done());`, use `if (holds)` for the invisible placeholder (:566), and give «Editar nota» its outlined style when `holds || made != null || makesTask` (:598). A note without open steps keeps its single filled «Editar nota» throughout.

4. Tests (App/test/meeting_screens_test.dart, near the D1 tests at :4278): (a) a meeting note with open steps whose `meetingNotesOverride` completes after a delay (add an optional delay or Completer to `meetingNotesOverride` in App/test/support/note_task_fakes.dart:84-93, keeping its current callers working): on the first frame there is no filled «Editar nota» (the outlined one and the hidden placeholder are there), and once it resolves «Crear tarea» shows filled with «Editar nota» outlined, with «Editar nota» at the same position it had on the first frame; (b) with the shell mounted and the marks read, opening the meeting note, going back and opening it again shows «Crear tarea» on the first frame both times; (c) a meeting note added to the task list after the marks were read (marks updated, task list changed) offers «Crear tarea» when its page opens; (d) the croquetas recipe note with steps, marks read, still shows one filled «Editar nota» and no «Crear tarea».
Don't touch: `noteMakesTask`, `noteTasksProvider`, `NoteTaskLinks`, the bar's copy or the order of its buttons, or anything about tasks (non-note) on the page.
acceptance: On a meeting note's page with open steps, in Spanish at 1× on 360×740, opened while the meeting marks are still loading: the first frame shows no filled «Editar nota»; when the marks resolve, filled «Crear tarea» and outlined «Editar nota» show, and «Editar nota» does not move.
At 2× text in Spanish, the same: «Editar nota» keeps its row from the first frame to the settled state (the hidden placeholder holds «Crear tarea»'s row above it).
With the app shell open and the marks read once, opening the same meeting note twice shows «Crear tarea» from the first frame on both opens (the marks are not re-read on open).
A meeting note saved after the marks were first read offers «Crear tarea» when its page opens.

The croquetas recipe note with open steps, marks read, shows a single filled «Editar nota» and no «Crear tarea» (render `notes/note.with-steps.es.light.1x` unchanged); a meeting note shows filled «Crear tarea» and outlined «Editar nota» (render `meetings/note.create-task.*` unchanged).
deviceChecks: On the emulator or a phone: open a meeting's note from Notas several times, and from the notes-ready notification on a cold start; the bottom bar never flashes the single «Editar nota» before «Crear tarea».

packages.title: Mark the meeting notes saved before D1, so they keep «Crear tarea»
brief: Context: D1 marks a meeting's note phone-locally when it is saved (`MeetingNoteMarks.add`, App/lib/services/meeting_note.dart:174-188, called in `saveNote`'s transaction at App/lib/services/meeting_store.dart:943). Notes saved by the released build (main's staging APK of 2026-11-04, schema 22) have no mark, so after this update they open with only «Editar nota». Some of them are still linked from a `meetings` row's `note_id` (rows are deleted once the result is seen, `markSeen`/`clean`, meeting_store.dart:1000-1030).

Add a one-time upgrade step: raise `TaskDatabase.schemaVersion` from 22 to 23 (App/lib/services/task_database.dart:17) and, in `upgrade` after the `oldVersion < 22` block (:271-275), add `if (oldVersion < 23 && newVersion >= 23)` that reads `SELECT DISTINCT m.owner_key, m.note_id FROM meetings m JOIN tasks t ON t.id = m.note_id AND t.owner_key = m.owner_key WHERE m.note_id IS NOT NULL` and calls `MeetingNoteMarks.add(db, owner, noteId)` for each row (it takes a DatabaseExecutor and merges with existing marks). A comment says why: notes saved before the marks existed (D1, UX-2905); the notes whose meeting row is already gone can't be told apart and stay unmarked, by design — never guess from a note's text. Fresh installs (onCreate) need nothing.
Check that the many tests calling `TaskDatabase.upgrade(sql, 3, TaskDatabase.schemaVersion)` still pass (the step runs on an empty meetings table there).

Test (App/test/meeting_core_test.dart): an in-memory database at version 22 with a note in `tasks` and a `meetings` row whose `note_id` points at it (and a second meeting row whose note no longer exists), no marks; after `upgrade(db, 22, 23)`, `MeetingNoteMarks.read` for that owner holds the existing note's id only; running the step on a database that already has marks keeps them.
Don't touch: meeting_store.dart, meeting_note.dart's format, or any other table.
acceptance: Upgrading a version-22 database with a saved meeting row whose note_id points at an existing note marks that note: MeetingNoteMarks.read returns its id for that owner, and its page then offers «Crear tarea» when it has open steps.
A meeting row whose note no longer exists adds no mark; existing marks are kept; a fresh database at version 23 has no marks.
deviceChecks: On the owner's phone with the released staging build: after installing this build, a meeting note saved before it whose meeting row still exists offers «Crear tarea»; older ones (row already cleaned) don't, as told to the owner.

packages.title: Pro screen: set the meeting hours apart from the example, and make the hours a plural
brief: Context: D4 (UX-2720) added the monthly meeting time to the Pro screen (App/lib/screens/subscription_screen.dart:132-141, the meeting reason; and the benefit line `proBenefitMeetingNotes`). Both are carried out as decided; two polish findings.

UX-3001 (S1): under the meeting reason the hours line sits 4 dp under the example (`const SizedBox(height: 4)`, :134) in the example's style, and the example has no final period on purpose, so «…las decisiones y las cosas por hacer Hasta 20 horas de reuniones al mes.» reads as one paragraph (at CA 2× the gap vanishes). Change that one SizedBox to `height: 8`, the step the card already uses between its other lines. No copy, style or colour change; the heading → example gap stays 4 dp.

UX-3002 (S1): `proBenefitMeetingNotes` and `billingReasonMeetingNotesLimit` take `{hours}` with no plural (App/lib/l10n/app_en.arb:4469 and :4490; app_es.arb:1507 and :1511; app_ca.arb:1211 and :1215). Make each a whole-sentence ICU plural, keeping the keys, the `int` placeholder and the text at 20 exactly as now. EN: proBenefitMeetingNotes `{hours, plural, =1{Notes from your recorded meetings, up to 1 hour a month} other{Notes from your recorded meetings, up to {hours} hours a month}}`; billingReasonMeetingNotesLimit `{hours, plural, =1{Up to 1 hour of meetings a month.} other{Up to {hours} hours of meetings a month.}}`. ES: `{hours, plural, =1{Notas de las reuniones que grabas, hasta 1 hora al mes} other{Notas de las reuniones que grabas, hasta {hours} horas al mes}}`; `{hours, plural, =1{Hasta 1 hora de reuniones al mes.} other{Hasta {hours} horas de reuniones al mes.}}`. CA: `{hours, plural, =1{Notes de les reunions que enregistres, fins a 1 hora al mes} other{Notes de les reunions que enregistres, fins a {hours} hores al mes}}`; `{hours, plural, =1{Fins a 1 hora de reunions al mes.} other{Fins a {hours} hores de reunions al mes.}}`. Then flutter gen-l10n.

Preview prose (not pixels): the descriptions of `meetings/pro · reason` (App/test/ux_previews/meeting_previews.dart:691-694), `settings/pro · free` (App/test/ux_previews/settings_previews.dart, the 'free' entries at :169-172 and :300-303, whichever opens the Pro screen) and `reminders/sheet · pro-screen` (App/test/ux_previews/reminders_previews.dart:296-298) still describe the copy without the hours. Add the hours line («Hasta 20 horas de reuniones al mes.», under the example) to the first, and «…, hasta 20 horas al mes» on the meeting benefit to the others. Add `es2` to the 'reason' preview's variants (today `[es1, ca2]`), since ES 2× of the meeting reason was never rendered.

Tests (App/test/subscription_screen_test.dart): the gap between `subscription-reason-example` and `subscription-meeting-limit` is at least 8 dp; `proBenefitMeetingNotes(1)` and `billingReasonMeetingNotesLimit(1)` read the singular in EN, ES and CA (“up to 1 hour a month”, «hasta 1 hora al mes», «fins a 1 hora al mes»; “Up to 1 hour of meetings a month.”, «Hasta 1 hora de reuniones al mes.», «Fins a 1 hora de reunions al mes.»), and 20 gives today's text unchanged.
Don't touch: `meetingHoursPerMonth` (App/lib/l10n/meeting_copy.dart:13), which benefit lines show for which reason (:192-193), the heading or the example copy.
acceptance: On the Pro screen opened for a meeting (free account taps «Grabar una reunión»), in Spanish at 1× and at 2× and in Catalan at 2×, there is a visible gap of at least 8 dp between «…las cosas por hacer» / «…les coses per fer» and «Hasta 20 horas de reuniones al mes.» / «Fins a 20 hores de reunions al mes.», and the heading → example gap is unchanged (renders `meetings/pro.reason.{es.light.1x, es.light.2x, ca.light.2x}`).

In EN, ES and CA, `billingReasonMeetingNotesLimit(20)` and `proBenefitMeetingNotes(20)` read exactly as before; with 1 they read the singular («Hasta 1 hora de reuniones al mes.», «Notas de las reuniones que grabas, hasta 1 hora al mes», and the EN and CA equivalents).
The INDEX descriptions of `meetings/pro · reason`, `settings/pro · free` and `reminders/sheet · pro-screen` mention the meeting hours.

decisions.question: The notes-ready notification on the lock screen (UX-3004, on D6/UX-2814): keep it as recorded, where the meeting's title still shows on a phone left at Android's default lock-screen setting, or hide the title always? Review D found that `NotificationVisibility.private` (App/lib/services/notification_service.dart:159) is already Android's default, so the change makes no difference on a phone: the title is hidden only where the person turned on “hide sensitive content”. That matches D6 as recorded. Options: (a) keep as recorded, no change; (b) a title-free lock-screen version, «Las notas de la reunión están listas», with the title once unlocked (needs native code: flutter_local_notifications 22.3.3 has no public-version option); (c) secret: the notification doesn't show on the lock screen at all.
decisions.recommendation: (a) keep as recorded: it is exactly what D6 says, it adds no native code, and a person who hides sensitive content on the lock screen gets the title hidden. Choose (b) only if you meant the title should never show on a locked phone; (c) hides that the notes are ready, which is the point of the notification. Either way, check both lock-screen settings on a phone.

decisions.question: «Hasta 20 horas al mes» and short meetings (UX-3003, on D4/UX-2720): keep the copy, or count by minutes? The server counts five-minute pieces, not minutes, and every meeting's last piece counts in full (Backend/core/meetings.py:302-318): a 2-minute call uses one of the 240, a 12-minute one three. Someone who records many short meetings runs out before 20 recorded hours. Options: (a) keep as is («Hasta» keeps it truthful); (b) count the last piece by its length on the server, so 20 hours means 20 recorded hours (server change, cost cap unchanged); (c) say «unas 20 horas».
decisions.recommendation: (a) keep as is: «Hasta» is truthful, and running out early takes about 8 short meetings a day every day of the month. If staging shows people running out early, do (b) on the server; the app's copy stays.

notes: For the owner (UX-2905): meeting notes saved by the staging build released on 2026-11-04 whose meeting row is already cleaned up can't be told apart from other notes, so they lose «Crear tarea» (they keep «Editar nota» and their steps). P329 marks the ones still traceable. Nothing is guessed from a note's text.

For the owner (D7, UX-2815): when you add the meeting line to the RevenueCat paywall, use the app's words with the hours: «Notas de las reuniones que grabas, hasta 20 horas al mes» (EN “Notes from your recorded meetings, up to 20 hours a month”, CA «Notes de les reunions que enregistres, fins a 20 hores al mes»), so the paywall and the Pro screen agree.

For the main session: this change adds a limit people will read («hasta 20 horas al mes», D4) and D5's audio line (MN-34). Per AGENTS.md, run /ux-web in ../TaskFlowWeb so the site states the same allowance and the same thing about the audio.

Ledger: UX-2720, UX-2721 and UX-2722 are carried out as decided (reviews C and D) and move to Verified; UX-2814 moves to Device check (carried out in code; the lock screen is a phone check); UX-2813 stays open until P327 is verified.
